next_action.description: The user is fixing SEAMS in the remove workflow. Removal repaints everything inside the mask, so precision now matters in a way it never did for detail/upscale - and mask_expand_pixels plus mask_blend_pixels 32 (tuned to hide seams on the old green-plate inpaint) now work against that. A tight mask with a fat blend is still a fat mask: A/B a much smaller blend once the boundary is accurate. Other live knobs: context_from_mask_extend_factor 1.20, output_padding 32, mask_hipass_filter 0.10, mask_fill_holes true. After seams, resume the Klein wiring at step 1 of the pending list.

key_decisions: All nine community LoRAs ship. CivitAI allowCommercialUse flags and the License badge are MODEL-level, not version-level; the three lacking the Image right are multi-base bundles whose restrictive label belongs to a Flux-dev leg we do not ship.
The NSFW LoRA ships and is PROMPT-GATED via MpiTextContains on Input_Positive - no control, no capability, no ModelDef entry.

Injection addresses one widget with a dotted Title.widget key. The style selector node MUST be titled Input_Style_Selector; that title is the contract, and a test derives it from the key the control emits.

Remove and inpaint need different graphs: crop/stitch helps when the answer is LOCAL (texture continuation) and hurts when it is GLOBAL (inventing a subject - the crop cut a cat tail and shifted tone). Padding cannot fix framing; mask_blend_pixels cannot fix tone.
Inpaint-to-ADD measured bad - the existing detail workflow beats it - so the split may collapse to remove-only. Retest before wiring an inpaint op.
The fal object-remove LoRA is rejected: it needs a red BOX drawn over a still-visible object, and it lost to the bare base model on a tattoo.
Turbo composes with the outpaint LoRA, and 4 steps beats 6-8 because extra steps let the model INVENT inside the mask (it grew a knee on a leg-tattoo removal).

Removal at ~4s is a tool rather than a generation - argues for reaching it from the mask UI via existing op-strip availability (absent vs disabled, MPI-356), NOT a separate tool or plugin. It needs no extra download: it runs weights Klein already installs.
